title: Rosalía 360º: decodificando el ADN de una motomami. Una Situación de Aprendizaje interdisciplinar en 1º de ESO Rosalia 360º: Decoding the DNA of a Motomami.
text_snippet: Rosalía 360º: decodificando el ADN de una motomami. Una Situación de Aprendizaje interdisciplinar en 1º de ESO Rosalia 360º: Decoding the DNA of a Motomami. This article describes a pedagogical proposal designed for the first year of Compulsory Secondary Education (ESO) in Andalusia. It is focused on the character of the Spanish singer Rosalía. The aim of the study is to present the artist as a model of an empowered, creative, and technically proficient woman by means of an interdisciplinary approach that integrates Music, Mathematics, Spanish Language and Literature, and English. The Learning Situation (SdA) is grounded in the current Andalusian regulatory framework (Order dated 30th May 2023) and it is developed according to the principles of Universal Design for Learning (UDL).

title: Intersecção entre educação física e currículo: reflexões sobre a tematização das lutas no cotidiano escolar Intersection between Physical Education and curriculum: reflections on the thematization of fights in everyday school
text_snippet: Intersecção entre educação física e currículo: reflexões sobre a tematização das lutas no cotidiano escolar Intersection between Physical Education and curriculum: reflections on the thematization of fights in everyday school The present study aims to critically analyze how the intersection between Physical Education and curriculum can enhance the thematization of fights in everyday school life, understanding this space as a fertile ground for resistance, transformation and construction of emancipatory pedagogical practices. The investigation was carried out with eight Physical Education teachers of basic education, from different regions of Brazil, selected through intentional typical sampling. As an instrument for the production of information, semi-structured interviews prepared by the researchers and carried out in a virtual environment via Google Meet were used. The empirical material was submitted to thematic analysis. The results show that, although current curricular policies try to standardize and restrict the pedagogical practice of Physical Education teachers under a neoliberal logic, they actively resist, tensioning and resignifying such impositions by promoting a politicized teaching committed to social transformation, enhancing the thematization of struggles in everyday school life.

title: Desafios e possibilidades das metodologias ativas na educação básica: uma revisão narrativa da literatura Challenges and possibilities of active methodologies in basic education: a narrative literature review
text_snippet: Desafios e possibilidades das metodologias ativas na educação básica: uma revisão narrativa da literatura Challenges and possibilities of active methodologies in basic education: a narrative literature review Given the social, technological, and pedagogical transformations of contemporary society, it is necessary to rethink the traditional teaching model, marked by repetitive and exclusionary practices. In this context, the importance of strategies that promote autonomy, student protagonism, and the collaborative construction of knowledge, in line with the competencies foreseen in the National Common Curricular Base (BNCC), is highlighted. Active methodologies present themselves as effective alternatives by expanding learning possibilities and favoring access, permanence, and school success, especially for historically excluded students. However, their implementation faces challenges, such as the lack of school infrastructure and adequate teacher training. Thus, this article discusses, through a literature review, the challenges and possibilities of active methodologies in basic education, highlighting their potential to promote more meaningful, inclusive learning aligned with the demands of a globalized society.

title: Por que a sombra me segue? A pergunta como método de argumentação na Educação Infantil Why does my shadow follow me? The question as a method for teaching argumentation in early childhood education
text_snippet: Por que a sombra me segue? A pergunta como método de argumentação na Educação Infantil Why does my shadow follow me? The question as a method for teaching argumentation in early childhood education The teaching of argumentation in Early Childhood Education is the focus of this article, which examines pedagogical practices organized around children’s questions and doubts. The study is based on the understanding that argumentation is a social and discursive practice present from early childhood, manifested through oral interactions, the justification of viewpoints, and the negotiation of meanings in everyday school contexts. Drawing on theoretical contributions from the fields of language studies, didactics, and Early Childhood Education, the article discusses pedagogical possibilities for teaching argumentation. This research adopts a qualitative approach, based on the observation of pedagogical practices and the use of a reflective field diary, analyzing discursive interactions in a preschool classroom. The results indicate that methodologies grounded in children’s questions foster the development of argumentative practices by promoting participation, hypothesis formulation, and the collective construction of meaning. It is concluded that the question constitutes a powerful methodological axis for teaching argumentation in Early Childhood Education

title: Vídeo-cartas a quem ousa brincar: tematização de brincadeiras populares no contexto de iniciação à docência Video-letters to those who dare to play: thematizing popular games in beginning teacher education
text_snippet: Vídeo-cartas a quem ousa brincar: tematização de brincadeiras populares no contexto de iniciação à docência Video-letters to those who dare to play: thematizing popular games in beginning teacher education A carta em tela assume natureza qualitativa e busca socializar a experiência de tematização das brincadeiras populares no contexto da Educação Física escolar em duas instituições municipais de São Gonçalo (RJ), com o compromisso de refletir sobre o diálogo estabelecido a partir das vídeo-cartas pedagógicas. Construída no âmbito do PIBID/UFRJ, a proposta inspira-se na perspectiva crítico-dialógica para traçar três movimentos metodológicos (imergir, tematizar e problematizar/emergir) ao longo de oito semanas. A experiência destaca os/as educandos/as como protagonistas do processo de ensino-aprendizagem, o diálogo entre as escolas e educandos/as da mesma cidade que vivem suas infâncias nos espaços do comum e as vídeo-cartas pedagógicas como possibilidades mobilizadoras para experienciar, ler e pronunciar as brincadeiras.

title: As representações das culturas afro-brasileiras nos livros de alfabetização: ausências e silenciamentos de um conteúdo Representations of Afro-Brazilian cultures in literacy textbooks: absences and silences of a content. Representaciones de las culturas afrobrasileñas en los libros de texto de alfabetización: ausencias y silencios de contenido.
text_snippet: As representações das culturas afro-brasileiras nos livros de alfabetização: ausências e silenciamentos de um conteúdo Representations of Afro-Brazilian cultures in literacy textbooks: absences and silences of a content. Representaciones de las culturas afrobrasileñas en los libros de texto de alfabetización: ausencias y silencios de contenido. Este artigo apresenta os resultados de uma pesquisa que objetivou compreender como se configuram as representações das culturas afro-brasileiras em gêneros textuais presentes nos livros didáticos de alfabetização, após a promulgação das Leis 10.639/2003 e 11.645/2008, e quais são as possibilidades para o letramento racial na infância. A pesquisa adotou uma metodologia mista (Spratt; Walker; Robson, 2004), fundamentando-se nos estudos sobre gêneros textuais e ensino (Bakhtin, 2011; Marcuschi, 2002), relações étnico-raciais (Brasil, 2003; 2004; 2008), educação intercultural e descolonizadora (Walsh, 2009; Candau, 2016; Gomes, 2020) e letramento racial (Twine, 2004). As análises demonstraram que os livros de alfabetização focalizam aspectos como corporeidade, musicalidade e literatura, sinalizando processos de mudança quanto à representatividade étnico-cultural. title: Articulações do currículo de Geografia no ensino médio com os territórios como dimensão educativa Articulations between the Geography curriculum in upper secondary education and territories as an educational dimension
text_snippet: Articulações do currículo de Geografia no ensino médio com os territórios como dimensão educativa Articulations between the Geography curriculum in upper secondary education and territories as an educational dimension Este artigo analisa transformações nas políticas curriculares brasileiras e catarinenses e na compreensão do território no ensino de Geografia no Ensino Médio. O objetivo consiste em examinar elementos conceituais que evidenciam o território como dimensão educativa nos documentos: Base Nacional Comum Curricular (BNCC), Proposta Curricular de Santa Catarina (1998 e 2014) e Currículo Base do Território Catarinense (CBTC, 2021). Adota-se abordagem qualitativa, com procedimentos bibliográficos e documentais. As categorias território, cidade, lugar e espaço orientaram a análise. Os resultados indicam que a BNCC apresenta orientação mais normativa e prescritiva, com tendência à homogeneização do ensino. Já as propostas curriculares catarinenses de 1998 e 2014 evidenciam perspectiva crítica e formativa. O CBTC procura articular diretrizes nacionais e regionais, ainda que revele tensões entre padronização curricular e contextualização territorial. Conclui-se que o currículo de Geografia pode constituir-se como espaço de valorização das experiências territoriais dos estudantes e de fortalecimento da formação cidadã.

title: Currículo e socioeducação: entre reprodução, reinvenção e resistência em territórios de vulnerabilidade Curriculum and socio-education: between reproduction, reinvention, and resistance in territories of vulnerability
text_snippet: Currículo e socioeducação: entre reprodução, reinvenção e resistência em territórios de vulnerabilidade Curriculum and socio-education: between reproduction, reinvention, and resistance in territories of vulnerability Este artigo tem como objetivo analisar como professores de escolas públicas que atendem adolescentes em cumprimento de medida socioeducativa em meio aberto reinventam o currículo em suas práticas pedagógicas, evidenciando-o como espaço de criação, movimento e possibilidade em contextos de vulnerabilidade social. Fundamentado nas contribuições de Sacristán, Freire, Arroyo, Lopes e Macedo, além de Bakhtin, o estudo toma o currículo como prática relacional. Trata-se de uma pesquisa de abordagem qualitativa, com objetivo exploratório, caracterizada como estudo de caso e desenvolvida por meio de pesquisa de campo. A produção dos dados ocorreu mediante entrevistas semiestruturadas realizadas com professores de escolas públicas. Os dados foram analisados por meio da Análise Dialógica Discursiva articulada à Análise Temática. Os resultados evidenciam que o currículo se constitui como prática em movimento, atravessada por tensões, negociações e experiências, produzindo processos de reinvenção curricular, nos quais o território, as trajetórias estudantis e as condições institucionais ressignificam as práticas pedagógicas. title: Entre barros e volumes: uma proposta de educação matemática crítica na comunidade quilombola Os Rufinos Between clay and volumes: a critical mathematics education proposal in the quilombola community Os Rufinos
text_snippet: Entre barros e volumes: uma proposta de educação matemática crítica na comunidade quilombola Os Rufinos Between clay and volumes: a critical mathematics education proposal in the quilombola community Os Rufinos Este artigo teve como objetivo analisar uma atividade matemática elaborada a partir da produção de louças da Comunidade Quilombola dos Rufinos (Pombal-PB), à luz dos ambientes de aprendizagem de Skovsmose. Com abordagem qualitativa, utilizou-se análise documental da atividade, que explora volume e capacidade. Os resultados evidenciam que a atividade contempla os ambientes com referência à matemática pura (1 e 2) e à semirrealidade (3 e 4), não sendo possível contemplar os que exigem referência à realidade (5 e 6), pois não envolveu coleta de dados em campo. As questões de maior destaque situam-se no ambiente 4, promovendo reflexão crítica e diálogo entre saber escolar e comunitário. Conclui-se que a proposta oferece um caminho para uma Educação Matemática Crítica que valoriza a cultura.

title: O que a refeição ensina: currículo e pertencimento na educação infantil What mealtime teaches: curriculum and belonging in early childhood education Lo que la comida enseña: currículo oculto y pertenencia en la educación infantil
text_snippet: O que a refeição ensina: currículo e pertencimento na educação infantil What mealtime teaches: curriculum and belonging in early childhood education Lo que la comida enseña: currículo oculto y pertenencia en la educación infantil Os momentos de alimentação na Educação Infantil não são apenas rotinas de cuidado ou intervalos entre atividades, mas espaços em que a escola ensina, de forma silenciosa, experiências de participação e pertencimento. Este artigo analisa como o currículo oculto e o currículo em ação se articulam na organização do tempo, do espaço e das relações durante as refeições, produzindo diferentes condições de participação entre as crianças. A análise articula a pesquisa bibliográfica e a interpretação de registros provenientes da prática docente. Os resultados indicam que o pertencimento não decorre apenas da presença das crianças, mas das condições concretas de participação constituídas no cotidiano. Conclui-se que, entre garantir o alimento e produzir pertencimento, existe uma dimensão relacional na qual se inscreve parte significativa da experiência escolar.

title: Educação antirracista e justiça curricular: significações de professores do ensino fundamental sobre a lei 10.639/2003 Anti-racist education and curricular justice: elementary school teachers' meanings about law 10.639/2003
text_snippet: Educação antirracista e justiça curricular: significações de professores do ensino fundamental sobre a lei 10.639/2003 Anti-racist education and curricular justice: elementary school teachers' meanings about law 10.639/2003 The objective of this article is to discuss the meanings that teachers in the Languages field attribute to the inclusion of Law No. 10,639/2003 in the implemented curriculum at the Elementary School level. The theoretical framework encompasses discussions on curriculum, curricular justice, and education for ethnic-racial relations. The qualitative methodology involved interviews with teachers working in the area of languages in primary education at a municipal public school in the northeast region of Santa Catarina. The analysis, using the Methodology of Meaning Nuclei, identified two main themes: a) teacher training and knowledge about curricular changes; b) school as a place of knowledge, cultural diversity, and anti-racist education. The struggle against structural racism in Brazil is a collective responsibility. However, the study showed that institutions still reproduce inequalities, which demands an ethical and political commitment to valuing diversity and combating racism.

title: Entre documentos e fotografia: vestígios das práticas educativas primárias nas escolas isoladas de Campos/SE (1927-1940) Between documents and photography: traces of primary educational practices in isolated schools in Campos/SE (1927-1940)
text_snippet: Entre documentos e fotografia: vestígios das práticas educativas primárias nas escolas isoladas de Campos/SE (1927-1940) Between documents and photography: traces of primary educational practices in isolated schools in Campos/SE (1927-1940) This study aims to analyze the educational practices of isolated schools in Campos/SE between 1927 and 1940, a period covered by documentation located in the Public Archives of the State of Sergipe, namely: monthly bulletins, daily attendance records completed by teachers, school inspector reports, communications, and a photograph. Aspects of their functioning were analyzed, as well as the daily lives of the teachers and students who were part of these educational institutions. The archived documents contain traces of the daily life of the schools, which are at risk of being lost in the dust of time. The research reveals names and educational practices from a time when teachers, alone in their homes or in other improvised spaces, conducted teaching and learning practices. However, these practices were monitored through documents such as bulletins, which brought the Board of Education closer to what was happening in the daily life of public schools in the interior of the state.

title: As religiões de matrizes africanas, imaginário e educação: uma revisão integrativa A brief integrative review on religions of African matrices, imaginary and education
text_snippet: As religiões de matrizes africanas, imaginário e educação: uma revisão integrativa A brief integrative review on religions of African matrices, imaginary and education The educational scenario has undergone major transformations in recent decades. In particular, studies that discuss the invisibility, combating racism, and religious intolerance of peoples of Afro-Brazilian culture have been receiving attention. In this scenario, it is important to look at research that goes beyond an essentially rationalist perspective, considering the contributions that studies that consider subjectivities, the sensitive, and the imaginary have made to this theme. Thus, this text seeks to systematize and analyze the main studies that focus on religions of African origin, the imaginary, and education, especially in research focused on the classroom. To this end, an integrative review of recent studies on the following platforms is used: Capes Journal Portal, SciELO, Brazilian Digital Library of Theses and Dissertations, and the Capes Theses and Dissertations Catalog; the result of which reveals that there are still some gaps in the understanding of the meaning of the concept of secularism in schools.

title: Inovação no ensino médico: plano de aula estruturado e jogo para reconhecer autismo Innovation in medical education: structured lesson plan and game to recognize autism
text_snippet: Inovação no ensino médico: plano de aula estruturado e jogo para reconhecer autismo Innovation in medical education: structured lesson plan and game to recognize autism Autism Spectrum Disorder shows an increasing prevalence, demanding medical training with high diagnostic accuracy in accordance with the new 2025 National Curriculum Guidelines. This study discusses the development of innovative educational products—a Structured Lesson Plan and the game “TEAlice in Wonderland”—as strategies for teaching ASD in undergraduate medical education. This is an applied research study, based on a situational diagnosis involving 127 medical students at USCS. The results indicate that the construction of tools based on active methodologies and the rigor of the DSM-5-TR allows for the transformation of complex technical criteria into meaningful learning. The TEAlice game, developed with generative artificial intelligence, integrates the “Playful Re-creation” (Recriar-se Lúdico) logic to exercise clinical reasoning and empathy. It is concluded that this pedagogical innovation meets the legal mandate of Resolution CNE/CES No. 3/2025, providing an effective response for curricular adjustment and ensuring inclusive care within Primary Health Care.

title: Uma revisão sistemática sobre os diferentes estilos de docência no desenvolvimento dos estudantes da educação básica On different teaching styles and the development of students in basic education
text_snippet: Uma revisão sistemática sobre os diferentes estilos de docência no desenvolvimento dos estudantes da educação básica On different teaching styles and the development of students in basic education The article presents a systematic review of the impact of teaching styles on the development of students in basic education, focusing on longitudinal studies published over the last eight years. The study is based on an adaptation of Baumrind’s categories, analyzed through the dimensions of control and support. The literature search was conducted in the ERIC database, resulting in the selection and analysis of 11 articles that met the inclusion criteria. Findings indicate that the authoritative teaching style is consistently associated with positive outcomes. However, the results also show that the effectiveness of teaching styles is not linear, varying according to students’ age, prior academic performance, and school context. The study concludes that the ideal teaching profile is dynamic rather than static, highlighting the need for further longitudinal research in the Brazilian educational context to inform better teaching practices.

title: Redes colaborativas de ensino, pesquisa e extensão na educação básica: uma revisão de literatura (2015-2025) Collaborative networks of teaching, research, and extension in basic education: a literature review (2015–2025)
text_snippet: Redes colaborativas de ensino, pesquisa e extensão na educação básica: uma revisão de literatura (2015-2025) Collaborative networks of teaching, research, and extension in basic education: a literature review (2015–2025) Collaborative networks for teaching, research, and extension in basic education constitute a key strategy for fostering connections among universities, schools, and communities, thereby supporting teacher professional development, the shared production of knowledge, and the strengthening of educational practices. This study aimed to analyze Brazilian academic literature on collaborative networks for teaching, research, and extension in basic education published between 2015 and 2025, identifying recurring concepts, experiences, and challenges. It is an integrative literature review based on searches across the SciELO, Brazilian Digital Library of Theses and Dissertations (BDTD/IBICT), CAPES Journal Portal, ERIC, and Google Scholar databases. Study selection followed predefined inclusion and exclusion criteria, and the selected works were analyzed using thematic analysis. The results show that the research converges on the understanding of collaborative networks as spaces for the collective construction of knowledge, continuing teacher education, and the integration of teaching, research, and extension. title: Avaliação da aprendizagem escolar: da pedagogia do exame à perspectiva formativa School learning assessment: from the pedagogy of testing to the formative perspective
text_snippet: Avaliação da aprendizagem escolar: da pedagogia do exame à perspectiva formativa School learning assessment: from the pedagogy of testing to the formative perspective This article aims to analyse learning assessment in its multiple dimensions, considering its origin, the concepts that underpin it, its different perspectives and functions, as well as the process of its consolidation in the Brazilian school context. The study is characterised as having a qualitative approach and, regarding its technical procedures, as a narrative review. The results show that learning assessment is a continuous and intentional process, based on the qualitative analysis of the data to support pedagogical decisions. It is structured in a diagnostic, formative, and summative manner, with a focus on mediation or regulation of learning. However, in the Brazilian context, the traditional, classificatory, and exclusionary logic, linked to the pedagogy of testing, prevails. It is concluded that it is necessary to reframe traditional assessment practices, transforming them into pedagogical instruments integrated into the educational process and focused on teacher reflection and the improvement of the teaching-learning process.

title: Pedagogia empresarial: o papel estratégico do pedagogo no ambiente corporativo
text_snippet: Pedagogia empresarial: o papel estratégico do pedagogo no ambiente corporativo This study aimed to analyze how pedagogues can contribute to organizational development through educational actions and the valorization of human capital. It is part of a broader analysis within the author's participation in the scientific initiation program. The research is qualitative and bibliographic in nature. It highlighted the main functions of the corporate pedagogue, such as training management, skills development, strengthening organizational culture, and mediation of interpersonal relationships. The results indicate that the pedagogue, with their didactic and pedagogical training, plays a fundamental role in promoting a continuous learning environment, acting as a facilitator, mediator, and agent of transformation within companies. Corporate pedagogy has gained space in the educational field as a strategic area of ​​action for the pedagogue in the corporate environment. It is concluded that the presence of this professional in organizations promotes innovation, quality of life at work, and human growth.

title: Perspectivas decoloniais para o ensino de matemática: uma reflexão acerca de epistemes silenciadas Decolonial perspectives for mathematics teaching: a reflection on some silenced epistemes
text_snippet: Perspectivas decoloniais para o ensino de matemática: uma reflexão acerca de epistemes silenciadas Decolonial perspectives for mathematics teaching: a reflection on some silenced epistemes This essay aims to discuss didactic-pedagogical possibilities for teaching Mathematics from an anti-racist perspective, which problematizes the supposed neutrality of school knowledge and promotes the recognition and appreciation of plural epistemologies, rooted in different sociocultural contexts. To this end, we conducted systematic searches and readings of academic works discussing ethnomathematics, decoloniality, and anti-racist mathematics education, aiming to construct arguments and critical reflections on mathematics teaching and the lack of discussions that guide Law 10.639/2003. The analysis was conducted through dialogues and reflections from a counter-hegemonic perspective and by proposing how mathematics can foster diverse discussions about other knowledges, not solely from a Eurocentric perspective. The results allow us to perceive other decolonial teaching practices and to learn about Black women who contributed to the development of mathematics and society, drawing on the knowledge of this science long considered masculinized and white.

title: Educação para relações étnico-raciais nos cursos de Humanidades das universidades federais do Nordeste Ethnic-Racial Relations Education in Humanities Courses at Federal Universities in Northeastern Brazil
text_snippet: Educação para relações étnico-raciais nos cursos de Humanidades das universidades federais do Nordeste Ethnic-Racial Relations Education in Humanities Courses at Federal Universities in Northeastern Brazil This article analyzes how undergraduate teaching programs in the Humanities at federal universities in Northeast Brazil incorporate, within their curricula, the principles of the National Curriculum Guidelines for the Education of Ethnic-Racial Relations (DCN-ERER). Through a qualitative documentary research, 2,810 syllabi of mandatory courses across 76 programs were examined, identifying 691 syllabi with content related to the theme—440 with a direct approach and 251 with an indirect approach. The analysis revealed varying levels of integration of the guidelines, with UNILAB standing out for having the highest proportion. The emphases varied: African heritage themes were more prominent at UFMA; Indigenous content was emphasized at UFBA, UFC, and UFRN; and race/gender intersectionality was most present at UFRN, UFC, and UniVASF. It was observed that the implementation of the DCNs is uneven across institutions, highlighting the need to consolidate these guidelines in order to strengthen anti-racist education.

title: Entre a política e a prática: cinema negro e educação antirracista nas disputas por visibilidade cultural Between politics and practice: black cinema and anti-racist education in disputes for cultural visibility
text_snippet: Entre a política e a prática: cinema negro e educação antirracista nas disputas por visibilidade cultural Between politics and practice: black cinema and anti-racist education in disputes for cultural visibility The article analyzes how affirmative public policies and cultural practices contribute to the appreciation of black cultures and the confrontation of structural racism in Brazil. From the articulation between cinema, education and cultural rights, the role of laws such as the Paulo Gustavo Law, the Aldir Blanc National Policy and Law 13.006/2014 in the promotion of black narratives in the school space is discussed. It reflects on contemporary black cinema as a language of resistance, memory and identity formation. With a qualitative and interdisciplinary approach, the study considers pedagogical experiences with audiovisual in formal and non-formal contexts, contributing to an anti-racist education. The proposal articulates culture, memory and public policies as fields of symbolic and historical dispute, defending the critical insertion of black cinema in educational processes.

title: Trabalho doméstico no Brasil: o protagonismo de Laudelina de Campos Melo (1904-1991) Domestic work in Brazil: the protagonism of Laudelina de Campos Melo (1904-1991)
text_snippet: Trabalho doméstico no Brasil: o protagonismo de Laudelina de Campos Melo (1904-1991) Domestic work in Brazil: the protagonism of Laudelina de Campos Melo (1904-1991) This article analyzes the central role of Laudelina de Campos Melo in the struggle for the social, legal, and educational recognition of domestic work in Brazil. It seeks to understand how her personal and political trajectory contributed to legal advances and to the development of educational practices focused on citizenship, anti-racism, and the valorization of domestic labor. The study adopts a historical, cultural, and legal approach, based on the analysis of biographies, historical documents, labor legislation, and recent statistical data on domestic work in Brazil. The theoretical framework draws on studies of coloniality, gender, race, and intersectionality, engaging authors such as Aníbal Quijano, Pierre Bourdieu, Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie, and Carlo Ginzburg. The findings reveal that, despite significant normative achievements, including Constitutional Amendment No. 72/2013, persistent structural inequalities reinforce the contemporary relevance of Laudelina de Campos Melo’s political and educational legacy.

title: Um feitiço ou uma canção? Uma análise das músicas do Pajubá de Linn da Quebrada A spell or a song? An analysis of the songs of Pajubá by Linn da Quebrada
text_snippet: Um feitiço ou uma canção? Uma análise das músicas do Pajubá de Linn da Quebrada A spell or a song? An analysis of the songs of Pajubá by Linn da Quebrada This study analyzes the lyrics of the album Pajubá (2017) by multi-artist Linn da Quebrada, focusing on the discourses about transvestites and their bodies, within a cisheteropatriarchal and phallocentric society. The research adopts the Materialist Discourse Analysis (Pêcheux, 1975, 1988) and engages with the fields of gender studies (Butler, 2011) and transfeminism (Nascimento, 2021). Nineteen discursive sequences were organized from the lyrics to investigate how meanings about transvestite experiences relate to already established social representations. It was found that Linn da Quebrada’s songs confront the stigmas imposed on trans* bodies, while also celebrating resistance. The study proposes a reflection on how music can serve as a form of subversion, challenging cisnormative standards and highlighting the experiences and strengths of trans* bodies in society.

title: Proposição de uma sequência didática para educação em suporte básico de vida no ensino fundamental
text_snippet: Proposição de uma sequência didática para educação em suporte básico de vida no ensino fundamental O objetivo deste artigo é apresentar uma sequência didática para o ensino de Suporte Básico de Vida (SBV) no ambiente escolar, voltada para crianças do 5º ano do Ensino Fundamental, elaborada a partir de uma dissertação de mestrado profissional. A proposta, fundamentada em uma abordagem multidisciplinar e prática, busca promover a educação em saúde ao incentivar a formação de alunos aptos a executar manobras de SBV, especialmente em situações de emergência, conforme orientações da American Heart Association (AHA). A sequência didática, fundamentada em Zabala (1998), inclui o plano de aula para o ensino de SBV e a criação de um manequim de baixo custo com materiais recicláveis, sendo ainda amparada por vídeos de treinamento autoinstrucional para os professores, garantindo a acessibilidade e a reprodutibilidade da prática em diferentes contextos escolares. O estudo também contribui para a inserção de temas de saúde no currículo escolar, fortalecendo a educação para a vida e a prevenção de situações de risco.

title: Culturas negras em sala de aula do Ensino Superior no Brasil: práticas pedagógicas antirracistas por meio da arte e literatura Black cultures in the classroom: antiracist pedagogies through art and literature
text_snippet: Culturas negras em sala de aula do Ensino Superior no Brasil: práticas pedagógicas antirracistas por meio da arte e literatura Black cultures in the classroom: antiracist pedagogies through art and literature The school, as a space for cultural and political construction, has historically contributed to the maintenance of ethnic-racial inequalities in Brazil. This article presents a systematic literature review that investigates antiracist pedagogical practices from basic to higher education, with an emphasis on the use of art and literature as tools for valuing Black and Afro-diasporic cultures. The search, conducted in the SciELO, Web of Science, and Scopus databases, resulted in 11 articles analyzed in full. The studies show that the inclusion of Black art and literature in pedagogical practices fosters identity recognition, the confrontation of racism, and the reconstruction of knowledge within educational settings. However, they also reveal challenges, such as institutional resistance and the lack of ongoing training on ethnic-racial relations. It is concluded that the implementation of an antiracist education requires a commitment to decolonial pedagogical practices and the restructuring of school and university curricula.

title: A tríade escuta-respeito-diálogo como eixo articulador para uma práxis intercultural decolonizada The listening-respect-dialogue triad as an articulating axis for a decolonized intercultural praxis
text_snippet: A tríade escuta-respeito-diálogo como eixo articulador para uma práxis intercultural decolonizada The listening-respect-dialogue triad as an articulating axis for a decolonized intercultural praxis The intercultural and decolonial approach is based on dialogicity, values the students' knowledge and seeks to think about reality from the outside of the Other (Dussel, 1994, 1998; Freire, 1967, 2022). This article aims to understand how the triad listening–respect–dialogue contributes to the teaching-learning process in Spanish language classes at a state school in the city of Boa Vista, Roraima, as the result of a qualitative research study associated with the decolonial approach. (Dussel, 1994, 1998; Grosfoguel, 2022; Silva Neto, 2020). The research instrument used in this study was participant observation of first grade high school classes and the use of a field diary to record the information. The analysis of the relationships established revealed the educator's challenges, but also possible intercultural didactics in Spanish language classes.

title: Confluências na educação quilombola: literatura, alimentação e territorialidade Confluences in quilombola education: literature, food, and territoriality
text_snippet: Confluências na educação quilombola: literatura, alimentação e territorialidade Confluences in quilombola education: literature, food, and territoriality This article presents data and reports experiences of teaching Literature in the context of Quilombola school education, implemented at Escola Municipal Quilombola Antônia do Socorro Silva Machado, an institution that integrates the territory of the Quilombola community of Paratibe, in João Pessoa, Paraíba. Aligned with the principles of a decolonial education that promotes knowledge in confluence with the community and its socio-environmental dimensions, the proposed readings were part of a thematic project focused on healthy eating, which gave rise to debates on food sovereignty and territoriality. Among the pedagogical practices, we highlight a heuristic walk in the forest within the Quilombola territory, a thematic seminar, and various classroom debates. Readings included Braga (2003), Assaré (1999), Melo Neto (2009), and Ribeiro (2021). For the theoretical and pedagogical framework, Santos (2023), Rufino (2021), Gomes (2020), Nascimento (2019), Pereira (2007), Pinheiro (2023) were consulted.

title: Vozes de crianças quilombolas de Nazaré e literatura para a infância: saberes, identidades e reflexões Voices of quilombo children from Nazaré and literature for children: knowledge, identities, and reflections
text_snippet: Vozes de crianças quilombolas de Nazaré e literatura para a infância: saberes, identidades e reflexões Voices of quilombo children from Nazaré and literature for children: knowledge, identities, and reflections This study aims to highlight the voices of children belonging to the Quilombola community of Nazaré, located in Itapipoca, Ceará, regarding their perceptions, feelings, and observations about children's literature with ethnic-racial themes. The research adopts an ethnographic approach, understanding that this allows the researcher to observe, listen, and distance themselves from their own cultural references, positioning themselves sensitively in the face of new realities and behaviors. Based on the narratives of ten children, aged between seven and ten years old, it becomes evident that literature constitutes a space for social, emancipatory, and assertive reflection, enabling the recognition and appreciation of the identities, subjectivities, and experiences specific to the Quilombola universe. The study thus reinforces the importance of literature that contributes to the affirmation of the cultural and symbolic worlds of Black childhoods.

title: Uma experiência musical com estudantes na Educação Infantil A Musical Experience in Early Childhood Education
text_snippet: Uma experiência musical com estudantes na Educação Infantil A Musical Experience in Early Childhood Education Music is a form of language and cultural production that makes significant contributions to human development. In early childhood education, it becomes an artistic expression of great educational value for children. This study aims to understand how pedagogical work with music in early childhood education fosters the development of artistic skills in children. Using a qualitative approach, this field study was conducted at an Early Childhood Education Center (CEI) in the municipal public school system of Fortaleza, with a Pre-Kindergarten II class composed of 20 children with an average age of 2 years. Based on the field study, it was observed that music education promotes not only cognitive learning but also processes of socialization, emotional expression, and the strengthening of children's identity.

title: Educação e práticas pedagógicas na comunidade quilombola Barreiro Grande, Serra do Ramalho-BA Education and pedagogical practices in the Barreiro Grande quilombola Community, Serra do Ramalho-BA
text_snippet: Educação e práticas pedagógicas na comunidade quilombola Barreiro Grande, Serra do Ramalho-BA Education and pedagogical practices in the Barreiro Grande quilombola Community, Serra do Ramalho-BA This article aims to analyze how the pedagogical practices at the Airton Senna School, situated in the Barreiro Grande Quilombola Community in Serra do Ramalho, Bahia, engage with the cultural knowledge and traditions of the community. This is a qualitative, descriptive study. Data were collected through semi-structured interviews, held between July 13th and 16th, 2022, and unsystematic observations. The research participants included teachers, the school administrator, and community leaders. They acknowledged the significance of incorporating the community's cultural practices into differentiated pedagogical approaches, while also criticizing the imposition of a Eurocentric curriculum by the municipal Department of Education, the lack of teaching materials aligned with the community’s context, and the need for more comprehensive teacher training. Despite these challenges, the school has fostered meaningful dialogue with local knowledge, particularly through its engagement with samba de roda.

title: Mostra Afro-Indígena Mosaicun e a construção de saberes afro-indígenas para uma educação antirracista e plural
text_snippet: Mostra Afro-Indígena Mosaicun e a construção de saberes afro-indígenas para uma educação antirracista e plural This paper analyzes the 4th Afro-Indigenous Art and Culture Exhibition (MOSAICUN), held at a public school in the Cariri region of Ceará, as an anti-racist pedagogical practice. The initiative promoted the recognition of ethno-racial identities by combining a decolonial curriculum with student protagonism. Through research, presentations, and visual productions, students explored the histories of Black women and local Indigenous place names, strengthening their sense of belonging and critical awareness. The exhibition contributed to valuing Afro-Indigenous knowledge, confronting structural racism, and gaining institutional recognition of the school as a space of resistance and inclusion. The study highlights the importance of continuous educational practices committed to social justice and aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals.

title: A prática copista nas aulas de língua portuguesa foi superada? O que mostram as evidências Have copying practices in Portuguese language classes been overcome? What the evidence shows
text_snippet: A prática copista nas aulas de língua portuguesa foi superada? O que mostram as evidências Have copying practices in Portuguese language classes been overcome? What the evidence shows The object of study of the Portuguese Language (PL) class has been discussed for at least forty years. The PCNs (1998) institutionalized the text as the guiding element of the PL class, a position reinforced by the BNCC (2018). In this scenario, the objective of the present research was to identify the current object of the PL class. The theoretical framework brings to the debate conceptions of language and language teaching, drawing on Applied Linguistics—focused on the didactic elaboration of classroom teaching—and Educational Sociolinguistics. The methodology consists of analyzing data taken from ten Supervised Internship reports (Elementary School) of the Languages (Portuguese Language) course at UNESC carried out in the second semester of 2022. Among the results, it is pointed out that the object of the PL class remains centered on classificatory and metalinguistic teaching, grounded in traditional grammar and largely perpetuated through copy-based practices.

title: Escrevivendo as diversas faces do racismo: uma cartografia com docentes negros de biologia Escrevivendo the many faces of racism: a cartography with black biology educators
text_snippet: Escrevivendo as diversas faces do racismo: uma cartografia com docentes negros de biologia Escrevivendo the many faces of racism: a cartography with black biology educators The aim of this study was to map the lived-writings of black biology teachers and their perceptions of racism in Brazil. This is a qualitative study, inspired by the cartographic perspective of Deleuze and Guattari, and associated with the writing-living of Conceição Evaristo. The research was carried out through virtual meetings on Google Meet, with discussions initiated by thought-provoking questions presented to the participants. A research journal was also used as a tool for data production. Among the main findings were: questions regarding self-identification, the pain experienced by teachers when recounting the many faces of racism, gender issues that affect Black educators, as well as the need to broaden the ethnic-racial debate in teacher education. These findings highlight the need to expand research on teacher training and the implementation of legal frameworks in schools, aiming to foster racial literacy starting in basic education.

title: Uma análise do livro Irmãs do Inhame de bell hooks: interseccionalidade e constituição de afrosubjetividade de mulheres negras An analysis of bell hooks' Sisters of the Yam: intersectionality and the constitution of afro-subjectivity in black women
text_snippet: Uma análise do livro Irmãs do Inhame de bell hooks: interseccionalidade e constituição de afrosubjetividade de mulheres negras An analysis of bell hooks' Sisters of the Yam: intersectionality and the constitution of afro-subjectivity in black women This article aims to promote intersectional analyses of the constitution of Afro-subjectivity among Black women in Brazil, based on a reading of bell hooks's literary work, "The Yam Sisters." The author engages in an insurgent movement, proposing creative and powerful epistemological elaborations about the resistance and existence of Black women. This work, which is the result of meetings organized by the Center for Research in Psychology and Ethnic-Racial Relations (NEGREPSI), is a bibliographic and exploratory study. Interdisciplinary references were used to consider the book's impact on the mental health of Black women and the fight against racial and gender-based violence. We conclude that "The Yam Sisters" has been fundamental in promoting reflections on the constitution of Afro-subjectivity among Black women, playing a crucial role in creating spaces for reflection and collective healing, by offering essential tools for emancipation and health.

title: A educação antirracista: contribuições para a área de matemática Anti-racist education: contributions to the field of Mathematics Educación antirracista y relaciones étnico-raciales: contribuciones al campo de las Matemáticas.
text_snippet: A educação antirracista: contribuições para a área de matemática Anti-racist education: contributions to the field of Mathematics Educación antirracista y relaciones étnico-raciales: contribuciones al campo de las Matemáticas. This article aims to map theses and dissertations that address Ethnic-Racial Relations from an anti-racist educational perspective, focusing on the field of Mathematics. Data collection was carried out in the Catalog of Theses and Dissertations of the Coordination for the Improvement of Higher Education Personnel (CAPES). We used the terms "Ethnic-Racial Relations" AND "Mathematics," filtering research from 2016 to 2025, within the broad area of ​​knowledge: Multidisciplinary, and the area of ​​knowledge: Science and Mathematics Education. Following the established criteria, 12 dissertations and 1 thesis were found, and their data were analyzed based on the Mapping of Educational Research. As a result, the analysis demonstrates the relevance of Ethnic-Racial Relations in the field of Mathematics Education, highlighting the importance of an anti-racist approach in the teaching of Exact Sciences. The selected research reveals that by integrating ethnic-racial issues into mathematics education, educators can promote a more inclusive and meaningful education that recognizes and values ​​the cultural diversity of students.

title: Sequência didática de A casa sonolenta: contribuições para escrita espontânea Didactic sequence of The Napping House: contributions to spontaneous writing
text_snippet: Sequência didática de A casa sonolenta: contribuições para escrita espontânea Didactic sequence of The Napping House: contributions to spontaneous writing This article is part of a research project developed for the undergraduate thesis in Pedagogy. The objective was to examine how a didactic sequence based on the book “The Napping House” can contribute to the development of spontaneous writing in children at the early literacy stage. The research was carried out in June 2025. The study was conducted in a public school in Quixada, Ceara. Methodologically, it draws on a qualitative, action-research approach. The authors who provided the theoretical foundation for this research include Ferreiro and Teberosky (1999), Morais (2012), Soares (2019), among others. The findings suggest that the integration of children’s literature into literacy practices fosters the development of spontaneous writing. The study also identified Rildo Cosson’s basic sequence as a valuable pedagogical strategy for teachers who experience difficulties in selecting an appropriate methodology for addressing literary reading. Moreover, the promotion of literary reading contributes significantly to the formation of readers.

title: Colonialismo linguístico, epistemicídio e relações étnico-raciais: a marginalização das línguas indígenas e africanas Linguistic colonialism, epistemicide and ethno-racial relations: the marginalization of Indigenous and African languages
text_snippet: Colonialismo linguístico, epistemicídio e relações étnico-raciais: a marginalização das línguas indígenas e africanas Linguistic colonialism, epistemicide and ethno-racial relations: the marginalization of Indigenous and African languages This paper discusses how practices inherited from linguistic colonialism and epistemicide persist in the requirements of graduate programs in Brazil. It aims to understand how the lack of recognition of marginalized languages and knowledge continues to sustain colonial structures that silence voices and forms of thought that diverge from the dominant logic. The study is qualitative in nature and draws on decolonial frameworks. Institutional documents related to language proficiency were analyzed, and testimonies from former students of the Federal University of Paraná and the University of São Paulo were also collected. The document analysis reveals the centrality of colonizer languages as proficiency criteria, while the languages of marginalized peoples remain ignored. As a result, this exclusion affects Indigenous, quilombola, Black, and African migrant students, whose languages and knowledge systems continue to be placed on the margins of academic legitimacy. The findings indicate that colonial languages continue to be treated as central to academic validation, whereas Indigenous and African languages remain unrecognized. This demonstrates

title: Capoeira Angola no Grupo Iuna: conhecimento ancestral africano e formas de relação contracolonial Capoeira Angola at Grupo Iuna: African Ancestral Knowledge and Counter-Colonial Relations
text_snippet: Capoeira Angola no Grupo Iuna: conhecimento ancestral africano e formas de relação contracolonial Capoeira Angola at Grupo Iuna: African Ancestral Knowledge and Counter-Colonial Relations In this article, we discuss African ancestral knowledge and counter-colonial forms of relationship based on the experience of the Grupo Iuna de Capoeira Angola. We start from the idea that this school preserves African ancestry in the research and teaching of Capoeira Angola. In dialogue with contemporary Latin American philosophy, we address the meanings and dynamics of Grupo Iuna, Capoeira Angola as African ancestral knowledge, the impacts of epistemicide on its understanding, the notion of the body as territory, and Capoeira as a force for quilombagem. We draw an analogy between the attack-defense dynamics inherent to the African fighting technique and the listen-speak relationship. This is a narrative writing supported by research that occurs through bodily movement and the exercise of orality. The central question guiding this work is: how does the African ancestral knowledge cultivated at Iuna teach co-living, promoting a counter-colonial way of being?

title: Brincadeiras africanas: Terra-Mar como ferramenta de afirmação da diversidade cultural na educação infantil African games: Terra-Mar as a tool for affirming cultural diversity in early childhood education
text_snippet: Brincadeiras africanas: Terra-Mar como ferramenta de afirmação da diversidade cultural na educação infantil African games: Terra-Mar as a tool for affirming cultural diversity in early childhood education This project was developed as part of the course “Projeto Integrador”, about “Multiculturalism in school environment”, a mandatory component of the Bachelor’s program in Pedagogy at the Virtual University of the State of São Paulo (Univesp). The objective of the project was to present and implement African games for students in final years of early childhood education, aiming to stimulate children’s interest and to value historically marginalized culture. The project was implemented at CEI 48 “Achilles Kloeckner”, in Sorocaba, SP, Brazil. The project followed a structured plan that included: research and planning; game selection; preliminary evaluation and feedback; implementation of the activity; discussion and reflection; future projections; and final evaluation and feedback. The project resulted in the development of a lesson plan; a brief lesson about Africa; the implementation of the Terra-Mar (Land-Sea) game; and the incorporation of multiculturalism into the school’s Political Pedagogical-Project (PPP).

title: Saberes indígenas e ensino de ciências: a Lei 11.645/08 na dinâmica das relações étnico-raciais Indigenous Knowledge and Science Teaching: Law 11.645/08 in the Dynamics of Ethnic-Racial Relations
text_snippet: Saberes indígenas e ensino de ciências: a Lei 11.645/08 na dinâmica das relações étnico-raciais Indigenous Knowledge and Science Teaching: Law 11.645/08 in the Dynamics of Ethnic-Racial Relations This article presents an integrative systematic review of Brazilian theses and dissertations on the implementation of Law nº 11.645/08 in Science Education, focusing on Indigenous knowledge and interculturality. Sixteen works available in the Brazilian Digital Library of Theses and Dissertations were analyzed according to thematic and methodological criteria. The study is grounded in the theoretical frameworks of interculturality, decoloniality, and ethnoscience, which guide the analysis of practices and curricula. The results indicate that the Law has been mobilized as both a legal and pedagogical instrument for valuing Indigenous knowledge and for re-signifying educational practices. While experiences related to biology and ecology are predominant, innovative proposals addressing chemistry and astronomy are also highlighted. Teacher education and the production of intercultural materials remain central challenges for the Law’s effective implementation. It is concluded that, despite progress, its application is still uneven, requiring public policies that promote a critical and anti-racist science education.
